# Conformance Requirements Checklist: Execution Backend Contracts

**Purpose**: Reviewer gate for requirements governing profiles, case applicability, deterministic
corpus execution, report integrity, and derived support claims
**Created**: 2026-09-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an
item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Profile and Case Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are common, family-specific, and claimed-capability profile responsibilities defined without duplicate or conflicting ownership? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025–FR-027, Plan §Contract layers]
- [x] CHK002 Does the corpus coverage requirement enumerate every constitutional conformance dimension applicable to this fixture-only slice? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, Constitution §V]
- [x] CHK003 Are mandatory, optional, and not-applicable case rules defined for every family/capability combination? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025–FR-027, US4]
- [x] CHK004 Are deterministic clock, seed, budgets, immutable inputs, expected observations, forbidden fields, and pass/fail criteria required for each case? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK005 Are cancellation, timeout, partial result, crash, malformed output, checkpoint, usage, health, provenance, credential isolation, idempotency, and reconciliation case classes covered? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Are conformant, optional-capability, and deliberately nonconformant fixture populations explicitly required for each fail-closed gate? [Completeness, Spec §FR-031, US4 Independent Test]

## Applicability and Support Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the rule for deciding whether a case is applicable deterministic and traceable to exact profile and capability versions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025–FR-027]
- [x] CHK008 Is an unsupported optional capability distinguished from a failed claimed capability and a not-applicable case? [Clarity, Spec US1-AS4, §FR-006, §FR-029]
- [x] CHK009 Is a complete conformance run defined so cancelled, skipped, unknown-version, expired, or partially written evidence cannot be mistaken for completion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028–FR-029, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Is “support” scoped separately for adapter release, connection revision, model relation, family profile, and capability set? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028–FR-029, Key Entities]
- [x] CHK011 Is evidence freshness defined independently from report integrity and mandatory-case success? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029, US4-AS3]
- [x] CHK012 Is test-only fixture conformance explicitly prevented from deriving real-provider, harness, authentication, or runtime support? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033–FR-035, Plan §Contract layers]

## Report and Evidence Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do report requirements consistently link adapter, connection configuration, model, profile, corpus, contract, evaluator, case, and artifact versions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028, §FR-032, SC-009]
- [x] CHK014 Do integrity-addressed report requirements distinguish normalized case evidence from observational timing fields excluded from reproducibility? [Consistency, Spec US4-AS2, §SC-008]
- [x] CHK015 Do report-summary requirements align with case-level mandatory/optional/applicability semantics and prevent contradictory aggregate status? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028–FR-029, Contracts §conformance-report]
- [x] CHK016 Does support derivation remain separate from adapter-authored report content and from connection eligibility policy? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-029]
- [x] CHK017 Do version compatibility requirements define how corpus, profile, contract, adapter, evaluator, and model versions affect report reuse? [Consistency, Spec §FR-030, US4-AS4]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Can repeated corpus outcomes be compared objectively with an explicit normalization boundary for time and other observational data? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008, US4-AS2]
- [x] CHK019 Can every prohibited support derivation in SC-007 be mapped to a distinct deterministic reason code and evidence state? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK020 Is complete mandatory-case passage measurable when optional and not-applicable cases coexist? [Measurability, Spec §FR-029, US4-AS1]
- [x] CHK021 Is the 500-case/60-second corpus envelope attached to a defined host, concurrency, seed, and fixture boundary rather than presented as universal performance? [Measurability, Plan §Technical Context]

## Exception and Recovery Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Are requirements present for crashes before case start, during observation, after evidence write, and before report/support commit? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Test Strategy]
- [x] CHK023 Are cancelled and timed-out conformance runs required to preserve partial evidence without deriving support? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-029]
- [x] CHK024 Are tampered manifest, case input, actual evidence, summary, artifact, and report-hash scenarios covered by fail-closed requirements? [Coverage, Spec US4-AS3, §FR-028–FR-029]
- [x] CHK025 Are stale lease, superseded configuration, adapter replacement, and late conformance result scenarios specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for a profile/capability case being removed, added, or reclassified across compatible versions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-030, Gap]

## Review and Traceability

- [x] CHK027 Is independent Quality ownership of conformance requirements and support evidence explicit enough to prevent self-certification by the adapter author? [Governance, Constitution §X, Spec US4]
- [x] CHK028 Are every support claim and route/result inspection requirement traceable to the exact report rather than a mutable display label? [Traceability, Spec US4-AS5, SC-009]
- [x] CHK029 Are corpus/profile changes required to preserve reviewable version history and compatibility impact? [Traceability, Constitution §XIX, Spec §FR-030]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and
  `$speckit-clarify`.
